Maya (Support): FYI customer 'borealis' just escalated — token cost dashboard showing $0 and NaN for several suborgs starting ~2026-03-16T23:00Z. They attached screenshot + CSV. Ticket #SUP-3891. Can we triage?
Alex (Product): Thanks Maya — any repro steps or org_id? Is this limited to one region/plan?
Maya (Support): Org ID 987654321. Happening for a subset of subaccounts on EU region only, appears after the nightly rollup. Repro steps I ran: 1) Visit Console > Billing > Token costs 2) Select date 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-17 3) See zeros/NaN for some rows. Export CSV shows `cost_usd` column with 0.00 and sometimes `NaN`.
Maya (Support): Quick paste of exported rows: 
```
org_id,subaccount_id,date,cost_usd
987654321,sub-17,2026-03-16,0.00
987654321,sub-23,2026-03-16,NaN
987654321,sub-42,2026-03-16,0.00
```
Priya (Backend): Can you run the internal ledger join query for that org and date and paste the last 20 rows? suspect is the rollup job producing NULLs then downstream agg dividing by zero.
Maya (Support): Pasted small sample from the internal API: 
```
GET /internal/ledgers?org=987654321&from=2026-03-16&to=2026-03-16
Response 200
[{"subaccount":"sub-17","tokens":1200,"cost":0.0},{"subaccount":"sub-23","tokens":0,"cost":null}]
```
Alex (Product): Hmm cost:null -> renderer might be converting to NaN, and zero tokens with a non-null price could lead to divide-by-zero in the rollup. Any errors in rollup logs?
infra-bot: nightly-rollup-job v2 completed 2026-03-16T23:05:12Z with exit code 0. Job id: rr-20260316-23. Retries: 1.
Priya (Backend): I just checked rollup logs (rr-20260316-23) — saw this stack fragment around 23:03: 
```
ERROR DataAggregator: aggregate_costs failed for partition org=987654321: invalid value encountered in double_scalars -> result=NaN
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "aggregator.py", line 214, in _merge_partitions
    avg_price = total_cost / total_tokens
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
```
Jordan (DataEng): That matches a change from PR #4512 last week — we switched to skip NULL prices earlier in pipeline, but we also changed ordering of the per-subaccount upsert. If a partition processed with tokens=0 and cost=NULL, total_tokens ended up 0 while total_cost stayed NULL -> downstream math produced NaN.
Jordan (DataEng): Quick mitigation: run the backfill that coalesces NULL cost to 0 before the agg, or make agg defensively handle total_tokens==0. I'll queue the backfill.
Priya (Backend): Proposed quick fix (safe): in aggregator.py wrap division: 
```
avg_price = total_cost / total_tokens if total_tokens > 0 else 0.0
```
Maya (Support): Customer wants ETA and mitigation now — can we do backfill today? They are P1-ing.
Jordan (DataEng): Backfill job scheduled 2026-03-17T01:30Z for org 987654321 (rr-backfill-987654321). Patch to aggregator placed in staging, will push to prod after smoke test. Backfill should fix historical NaNs/zeros for affected dates and repopulate dashboard caches.
Alex (Product): Please add a short on-call mitigation runbook step: "If dashboard shows NaN/0 for subset, run backfill for org and deploy defensive divisor check."
Priya (Backend): I'll cut the hotfix after backfill validation, we should be able to deploy within 90m.
Maya (Support): Noted. I've informed customer and asked to hold off changes until we confirm. They'll provide sample CSV from their side too. :thumbsup:
Maya (Support): Will update the ticket when rr-backfill-987654321 completes.
infra-bot: Backfill job rr-backfill-987654321 started at 2026-03-17T01:30:12Z.
Jordan (DataEng): Backfill logs show 312 rows updated for org 987654321, NaN -> 0 coercion + re-agg complete.
Maya (Support): Confirmed with customer — dashboard values restored for their subaccounts. Customer is happy for now, keeping ticket open for postmortem and long-term fix.
Alex (Product): Thanks team. I opened a follow-up ticket to add unit tests around total_tokens==0 and a rollout to avoid regressions. :white_check_mark:
